chain.stated: I take in the room and wait for whoever speaks first.

message.text: The low beams of The Drowned Lantern hold the hush after speaking. Salt-rot hangs in the air, thick and familiar, and the single hearth pops softly to itself. Across the room, far off beyond the bar, the front door sits shut against the night. The bar with its closed hatch stands between you and Jonas, and he has not moved from that ground. Behind you, the back door to the alley is there, and somewhere underfoot the cellar hatch lies dark in the floorboards. No one fills the silence Jonas left; no one steps forward to break it. The hooded figure near the ballast crate gave you a long look, and now only studies her cup. Mara watches from the bar, her dry warning still hanging in the quiet, and waits.
